stem: \[ax + by = 10\] \[bx + ay = 8\] In the system of equations above, \(a\) and \(b\) are constants. If the solution to the system is \((2, 1)\), what is the value of \(a\)?
solution: From the first, \(b = 10 - 2a\). Substitute: \(2(10 - 2a) + a = 8\), so \(20 - 3a = 8\) and \(a = 4\).
(Then \(b = 2\); the system \(4x + 2y = 10\), \(2x + 4y = 8\) has the single solution \((2, 1)\).)
verify:
x, y, a, b = symbols('x y a b')
sol = solve([2*a + b - 10, 2*b + a - 8], [a, b])
assert sol == {a: 4, b: 2}
assert linsolve([4*x + 2*y - 10, 2*x + 4*y - 8], [x, y]) == FiniteSet((2, 1))
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == [sol[a]]
